user.title: Task Wheel of Fortune
user.description: Distribute household tasks fairly with a wheel of fortune. Persons, tasks and schedules are managed in the panel afterwards.

abort.already_configured: Task Wheel of Fortune is already set up.

data_description.jokers_per_month: How often a person may swap a task per calendar month.
data_description.fairness_window_days: How far back points count for the fair weighting.
data_description.history_retention_days: How long rounds stay in the history; monthly statistics are kept.
data_description.late_points_factor: Share of the points for tasks completed late (0 to 1).
data_description.missed_points_factor: Share of the points for missed tasks (−1 to 0, negative deducts points).
data_description.missed_grace_hours: How long after the deadline a task does not yet count as missed.
data_description.panel_admin_only: If enabled, only administrators see the panel and only they may use the services, the button and the to-do lists (automations stay allowed).

draw.name: Draw
draw.description: Draws a round for a schedule without the panel.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Slug or ID of the schedule.

animate_on.name: Display
animate_on.description: Entity of a display that should also show the draw via an event.

assignment_id.name: Assignment
assignment_id.description: ID of the assignment (alternatively person and task).

person.name: Person
person.description: Slug or ID of the person.

task.name: Task
task.description: Name or ID of the task.

swap.name: Swap
swap.description: Hands an open assignment to another person using a swap.

to_person.name: New person
to_person.description: Slug or ID of the receiving person.

set_absence.name: Set absence
set_absence.description: Adds a one-time absence (e.g. from a calendar automation).

person.name: Person
person.description: Slug or ID of the person.
